subject: correct type internal to kvstore (minor) (#1246)
reason: The change only narrows two private struct fields in src/kvstore.c (num_dicts, num_dicts_bits) from long long to int. Their values are capped by assert(num_dicts_bits <= 16) in kvstoreCreate, so num_dicts <= 65536 always fits an int, and the public accessor kvstoreNumDicts already returned int. No command reply, data layout, replication, or persistence behavior can change; it is a pure refactor with no observable effect, so no scenario is warranted.
